DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。行事の受付はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. This is the event reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 工作の行事に参加したいです。入口の募金箱へ参加費を入れようとしましたが、支払先が違うかもしれないので先に聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 募金箱へ工作参加費を入れかけたが支払先を先に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take part in the craft event. I was about to put the participation fee into the donation box at the entrance, but I came to ask first because it might be the wrong place to pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you nearly put the craft participation fee into the donation box and want to check where to pay first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お金はもう箱へ入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already put the money into the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、まだ手元にあります。箱に公園の整備への募金と書いてあって、工作の参加料とは書かれていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未投入で箱表示は公園整備募金で参加料ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I still have it with me. The box says donations for park maintenance; it doesn't say craft participation fees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not put the money in and the box is marked for park maintenance donations, not participation fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 募金は任意の寄付です。工作の受付や参加費とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Donations are voluntary contributions. They are separate from craft registration and participation fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 寄付をすれば工作の席も確保できるという意味ではないのですね。子ども一人の参加を受付で申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 寄付は席確保ではないと確認し子ども一人の参加を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So making a donation doesn't mean a craft place is reserved. I'd like to register one child at the reception desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that donating does not reserve a place and request participation for one child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加できる枠と費用をご案内します。寄付の有無は別にお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain the available places and costs. Please decide separately whether to donate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず子ども一人の空き枠と参加費を確認します。私は付き添いなので、私の分の材料も必要かをあわせて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空き枠参加費と付き添いの親にも材料が必要かを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: First, I'll check availability and the fee for one child. I'm accompanying them, so I'd also like to ask whether materials are required for me too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about availability, the fee, and whether an accompanying parent also needs materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 参加人数と付き添いの扱いを確認してから、お支払いをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll confirm the number of participants and the arrangements for accompanying people before explaining payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。募金箱には参加費を入れず、子どもと付き添いの条件を確認して受付で手続きします。寄付をするかは、その後に別で決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加費は募金箱へ入れず参加付き添い条件確認後受付手続きし寄付は別に決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't put the participation fee in the donation box. I'll check the conditions for the child and accompanying person, then register at reception. I'll decide separately afterward whether to donate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not put the fee in the donation box, will register after checking the participation and accompanying conditions, and will decide about donating separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。工作の参加案内をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you the craft participation information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。切符のことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help with your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 券売機から紙が二枚出ました。一枚を財布に入れ、今は領収書を持っているようなので、改札へ行く前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 券売機二紙のうち領収書を持った疑いで改札前確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two pieces of paper came out of the ticket machine. I put one in my wallet, and I seem to be holding the receipt now, so I'd like to check before going to the ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you may be holding the receipt from the two papers issued by the machine and want to check before the gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: もう一枚も取り出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you take out the other one too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。行先がある紙と、金額が大きく書かれた紙を取り違えたと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 財布から行先紙と金額紙を出し取り違えを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here it is. I think I mixed up the paper showing the destination and the one with the amount printed prominently.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Take the destination paper and amount paper out of your wallet and explain the mix-up in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗車券の表示と領収書の表示を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the ticket marking and receipt marking separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらが乗車券ですね。領収書も経費のために残しますが、乗車券の代わりにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車券と領収書を区別し領収書は経費保存で代用しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one is the ticket, then. I'll also keep the receipt for expenses, but I won't use it in place of the ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the ticket from the receipt in Japanese and say you will keep the receipt for expenses, not use it as a substitute.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用する区間も、乗車券でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check your travel section on the ticket too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 行先は合っています。財布には経費用の領収書を入れ、乗車券は使うために別に持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗車区間確認後領収書を財布券を手元へ分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The destination is correct. I'll put the expense receipt in my wallet and keep the ticket separate to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after checking the travel section, you will put the receipt in your wallet and keep the ticket at hand separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二枚とも取り忘れずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please remember to take both papers with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書だけで進まず、乗車券を確認して改札へ向かいます。金額の表示だけで紙を選びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額だけで紙を選ばず実乗車券で改札へ行くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't proceed with just the receipt. I'll check the ticket and head to the gate. I won't choose the paper based only on the amount displayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the actual ticket at the gate and will not select a paper based solely on the displayed amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気をつけてご乗車ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。記入のお手伝いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like help filling this in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 生年月日の西暦欄に十年と書きかけました。平成十年生まれなので、元号の年数をそのまま入れない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 西暦欄へ平成十年の十だけ書く前に表記確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to write ten in the Western-calendar birth-year field. I was born in Heisei ten, so I shouldn't put the era year directly into that field, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check in Japanese how to write the year before entering only ten from Heisei ten in the Western-calendar field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 西暦の生年が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a document showing your birth year in the Western calendar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人確認の資料では千九百九十八年です。十という数字だけだと、その年にはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人資料西暦千九百九十八で十単独は同年でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My identification document says 1998. The number ten on its own doesn't mean that year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your identification shows 1998 and that ten alone does not indicate the same year.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この西暦欄には、資料の年を使って記載してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use the year shown on your document in this Western-calendar field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 千九百九十八年へ直します。月と日は同じまま、年の表し方をそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 西暦年へ直し月日は維持して表現をそろえると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll correct it to 1998. I'll keep the month and day unchanged and make the year notation consistent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will correct the year to the Western calendar, keeping the month and day unchanged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの用紙では、元号を書く形式もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Some other forms use a Japanese-era format.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 毎回同じ短い数字を写さず、西暦か元号付きかの欄名を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 各用紙の西暦元号形式を読み数字だけ転記しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't copy the same short number every time. I'll read the field label to see whether it asks for the Western year or a year with an era name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check each form's Western-calendar or era format instead of copying only the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記載した年月日を確認してからご提出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the date you have entered before submitting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料の千九百九十八年と月日を照合します。平成十年という説明と西暦の表記を混ぜません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料年月日と照合し元号年数と西暦を混ぜず提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll compare the year 1998, month and day with my document. I won't mix the explanation Heisei ten with Western-calendar notation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will compare the full date with the document and submit without mixing era years and Western-calendar years.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入した欄を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let me look at the field you filled in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。持参資料についてお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with the documents you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別の医療機関から画像のディスクを渡されました。家で見られなかったので、空だと思って使い直す前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 医療画像ディスクを家庭で再生できず空と考え再利用前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Another medical institution gave me an imaging disc. I couldn't view it at home, so I thought it was empty, but I want to ask before reusing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you could not play the medical imaging disc at home, thought it was empty, and want to ask before reusing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ラベルや一緒に渡された紙はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have its label or the paper that came with it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、画像資料と私の名前があります。家の再生機では画面が出ませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画像ラベル本人名説明紙あり家庭機で未表示と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It says imaging records and has my name. Nothing appeared on my player at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have the imaging label, your name and accompanying paper, but nothing displayed on your home player.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家庭の再生機で見えないことと、資料が空であることは別です。担当へそのままお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Not being able to view it on a home player doesn't mean the disc is empty. Please show it to the person in charge as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分の動画を書き込んだり、読みやすくするために消したりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未再生と空を区別し動画上書きや自己消去しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I won't record my own videos onto it or erase it to make it easier to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you distinguish failure to play from an empty disc and will not overwrite it with videos or erase it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料の中身や読取りは、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the contents and whether they can be read.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋と説明紙も一緒に渡します。見られなかった再生機のことは説明しますが、資料が壊れたとは断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋説明紙と再生機状況を伝え破損と断定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll hand over the sleeve and explanation sheet too. I'll explain which player couldn't display it, but I won't conclude that the disc is damaged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will provide the sleeve, explanation sheet and player details without declaring the disc damaged.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の名前も確認してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check that it has your name before bringing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前を確認しました。家で再生できなかった状態のまま、上書きせず担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前照合し現状態無上書きで担当へ渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked my name. I'll hand it to the person in charge in the same state it was in when I couldn't play it at home, without overwriting anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have checked the name and will hand it over as it is without overwriting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料受付へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the records reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談メモでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with your consultation note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母語のメモを翻訳しましたが、日本語が私の意図より強くなっています。そのまま自分の発言として出す前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翻訳メモが意図より強く自分の発言扱いの提出前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I translated a note from my native language, but the Japanese sounds stronger than I intended. I'd like to check before submitting it as my own statement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the translated note is stronger than intended and ask for help before submitting it as your own statement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どういう内容を伝えたかったのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did you want to communicate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 不安になったと伝えたいです。翻訳では相手が危険な人だと断定する文になっていますが、その判断はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人意図不安感が翻訳で相手危険人物断定となったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to say that I felt uneasy. The translation states that the other person is dangerous, but I haven't made that judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you intended to describe feeling uneasy, but the translation asserts that the other person is dangerous.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 気持ちと、相手について確認した事実を分けて説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish your feelings from facts you have confirmed about the other person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 不安を感じたことは私の気持ちです。相手が何をしたかは、実際に見た内容だけ別に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人感情と実見事実を分けて話すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Feeling uneasy is my personal feeling. I'll describe separately only what I actually saw the other person do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate your feelings from facts you directly observed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元の母語のメモも残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the original note in your native language too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残しています。翻訳を直しても元の内容を消さず、どの文の意図が違ったか示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 母語原文保持で修正翻訳の意図差を示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have it. Even when correcting the translation, I'll keep the original content and show which sentences convey a different intention.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will retain the native-language original and identify differences in meaning in the corrected translation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な言語の支援についても担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also consult the person in charge about support in the language you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日本語が不十分な所は支援をお願いします。翻訳の断定文を私の実際の発言や確認済み事実とはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 言語支援を頼み翻訳断定を本人発言や確定事実としないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd appreciate support where my Japanese is insufficient. I won't treat the translation's definitive statements as my actual words or confirmed facts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request language support in Japanese and say that definitive translated statements are not your own statements or established facts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。元のメモと一緒にお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll listen to your explanation together with the original note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便の表示でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with the markings on your mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 親展と書いた封筒を送りたいです。家族で開けて伝えてほしい意味だと思っていましたが、本人に見てほしい表示なのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 親展が家族開封伝達でなく本人閲覧の表示か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send an envelope marked shinten, or private. I thought it meant the family should open it and pass on the message. Does it actually mean I want the addressee to read it personally?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether shinten means personal reading by the addressee rather than opening and relaying by family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 親展は、宛名の本人に開いて見てほしいという表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Shinten means you would like the named addressee to open and read it personally.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。父本人に読んでほしい手紙なので、その意味で使います。家族へ開封を頼む表示ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父本人への手紙で家族開封依頼表示ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. This is a letter I want my father himself to read, so I'll use it with that meaning. It isn't a request for his family to open it, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that it is a letter to your father personally, not a marking asking family to open it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示は配達方法そのものの指定とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That marking is separate from specifying the delivery method itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受取人本人への手渡しが必ず保証されるとも考えません。必要な配達方法は別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示だけで本人手渡し保証とせず配達方法は別相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume it necessarily guarantees hand delivery to the addressee either. I'll ask separately about the delivery method I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the marking alone does not guarantee personal hand delivery and that you will ask about delivery methods separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛名はお父さまの名前で書いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you addressed it using your father's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、父の名前です。家族全員宛てと混ぜず、私の希望も手紙の中に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 父個人宛で家族全員と混ぜず希望を文面にも書くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it's his name. I won't confuse that with addressing the whole family, and I'll also write my wishes inside the letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it is addressed to your father individually, not the whole family, and you will write your wishes in the letter too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送付方法をご希望に応じてご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can explain sending options according to your preferences.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 親展の意味と送付方法を分けます。本人へ読んでほしい手紙として宛名を確認して差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 親展の意味と送付サービスを分け本人宛を確認して発送すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distinguish the meaning of shinten from the sending method. I'll check the addressee and send it as a letter I want him to read personally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish the marking's meaning from postal services, check the personal addressee and send the letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。送付のご希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please tell me how you would like it sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。画面の案内でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble with the on-screen instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 操作の説明画面に五十万円とありました。自分の残高だと思いましたが、見本と書いてあるので、実際の口座とは別か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明画面五十万円が本人残高か見本か確認したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The operation guide screen showed 500,000 yen. I thought it was my balance, but it says sample, so I'd like to check whether it's separate from my actual account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the 500,000 yen on the instruction screen is your own balance or a sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は説明用の画面で、ご自身の口座情報を開いていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You're on an explanation screen now, without opening your own account information, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだログインしていません。数字だけを見て、家族へ残高が増えたと連絡しそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未ログインで数字だけで家族へ増残報告しそうだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I haven't logged in yet. Just from seeing the number, I nearly told my family that my balance had increased.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not logged in and nearly told your family of an increased balance based only on the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見本の数字はご自身の預金を示した物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The sample number does not indicate your own deposits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その数字を家計に写さず、見本として読みます。自分の口座の確認方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見本数値を家計へ転記せず本人照会方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll read it as a sample and won't enter that number in my household accounts. I'd like to know how to check my own account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to check your own account, saying you will not copy the sample number into household accounts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用案内に従って、ご自身の情報を確認してください。操作に迷えば担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please follow the user guide to check your own information. If you are unsure how to operate it, you can ask the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 画面が変わったら、自分の口座情報かも確認します。説明ページの写真だけで入金があったとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人口座画面か確認し説明画像で入金主張しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: When the screen changes, I'll also check whether it's my own account information. I won't say money was deposited based only on a picture of the instructions page.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check whether it is your account screen and will not claim a deposit based on an instruction image.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見本と実際の照会結果を区別してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish the sample from actual account inquiry results.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族への連絡は実際の照会後にします。五十万円は操作見本の数字だったと理解しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見本と照会を区別し家族報告は実照会後と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll contact my family after making an actual inquiry. I understand that 500,000 yen was a number in the operation example.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you distinguish examples from inquiry results and will report to your family after checking the actual account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。照会の案内をこちらでご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain the inquiry instructions here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お買い物をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲料を二箱買いたいですが、家の階段を一人で運べません。買ってから配達を当然のように頼まず、先に利用できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人で運べない飲料二箱を会計前に配達可否相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy two cases of drinks, but I can't carry them up my stairs alone. Rather than assume I can request delivery after buying, I'd like to ask whether it's available first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether delivery is available for two cases of drinks you cannot carry alone, before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取る場所や時刻の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a preferred delivery location or time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二階の部屋で、夕方は私がいます。建物にエレベーターはありません。入口での受取りなら、運ぶ手伝いを別に頼む必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二階無エレベーター夕方在宅で玄関渡しなら別介助必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's a room on the second floor, and I'm home in the evening. The building has no elevator. If delivery is only to the entrance, I'll need to arrange separate help carrying them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you live on the second floor without an elevator, are home in the evening, and need separate carrying help if delivery stops at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達の有無や受渡し場所、料金を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the person in charge about delivery availability, the handover location and charges.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家までという言葉だけで、部屋の中まで運んでもらえるとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配達有無場所料金を聞き家宛を室内搬入保証としないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I won't assume that the words to your home mean they will carry everything inside my room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about delivery availability, location and fees, and say that home delivery does not guarantee carrying items inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当の案内を聞いてから、購入する数をお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please decide how many to buy after hearing the person's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 希望に合わなければ、今日は一箱だけにして友人と運びます。二箱買ってから条件を変えてもらおうとはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件合わなければ一箱友人介助とし購入後条件変更要求しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the conditions don't suit me, I'll buy only one case today and carry it with a friend. I won't buy two cases and then try to have the conditions changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that if the conditions do not suit, you will take one case with a friend's help and will not demand changes after purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入前に受取りの準備をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your arrangements for receiving the goods before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 階段と受渡し場所を説明して、配達条件を聞きます。条件と運び方が決まってから箱数を確定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 階段受渡し情報で条件運び方を決め箱数確定すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the stairs and handover location and ask about delivery conditions. I'll finalize the number of cases after deciding on the conditions and how to carry them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain the stairs and handover details, decide on conditions and carrying arrangements, then confirm the quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll take you to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。コースの案内をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with information about the route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この先の花の広場へ行きたいです。徒歩十五分とありますが、友人へ十五分後に必ず着くと伝えてよい目安ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩十五分を必着約束とせず花広場への案内を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to the flower plaza up ahead. The sign says a fifteen-minute walk, but that isn't a basis for promising my friend I'll definitely arrive in fifteen minutes, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for directions to the flower plaza, without treating a fifteen-minute walk as a guaranteed arrival promise.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 途中で休んだり寄り道したりする予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you planning to rest or stop along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真を撮り、休憩もしたいです。歩き続ける人の目安より時間がかかるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影休憩予定で連続歩行目安より時間がかかる可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to take photos and rest too. It may take longer than the estimate for someone walking continuously.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you plan to take photos and rest, so it may take longer than the continuous-walking estimate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 目安の時間と、ご自身の行動の予定を分けて考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish the estimated time from your own planned activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人には今から向かうと伝え、確かな到着時刻はまだ言いません。寄り道するならその連絡もします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ出発と寄道を共有し確実到着時刻を未保証と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell my friend I'm heading there now, but I won't give a definite arrival time yet. If I make stops, I'll let them know that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your friend about departure and stops without guaranteeing a definite arrival time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 集合する場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided where to meet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 花の広場の入口です。広場に入ってから探し回らないよう、入口の案内板を目印にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 花広場入口案内板を集合目印として具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the entrance to the flower plaza. I'll use the information board at the entrance as a landmark so we don't have to search around inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese that the information board at the flower plaza entrance is the meeting landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所と予定を共有してからお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please share the location and plans before continuing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 徒歩目安、寄り道予定、集合の目印を分けて伝えます。十五分の表示を約束の時刻として保証しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩行目安寄道集合目印を区別し十五分保証としないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the walking estimate, planned stops and meeting landmark separately. I won't guarantee the displayed fifteen minutes as a promised arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you distinguish the walking estimate, stops and meeting landmark and do not guarantee fifteen minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。どうぞお気をつけてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take care as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。駅で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything at the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここに六人集まりますが、列車に乗るのは四人です。二人は見送りだけなので、乗る人数と分けて案内をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集合六人のうち四人乗車二人見送りで人数を区別して案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Six of us are gathering here, but only four are taking the train. Two are just seeing us off, so please distinguish them from the travelers when giving directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that six are meeting, four will board and two are seeing them off, and request guidance distinguishing those numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗車する四人は、もうおそろいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are all four travelers here already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は三人です。あと一人が改札の外へ来ます。見送りの二人が来ても、乗る四人がそろったことにはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車者は三人到着で見送りが来ても四人はそろわないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only three are here now. One more is coming outside the ticket gate. Even if the two seeing us off arrive, that doesn't mean all four travelers are here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that three travelers have arrived and the arrival of the people seeing them off will not complete the four travelers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。乗る方の切符は、それぞれがお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Do the travelers each have their own ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人分だけ私が預かっています。まだ来ていない人の分なので、見送りの友人に渡さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 預かり切符は未到着乗車者の分で見送りへ渡さないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm holding one person's ticket. It's for the person who hasn't arrived yet, so I'll make sure not to hand it to a friend who is only seeing us off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the ticket you are holding belongs to the traveler who has not arrived, and you will not give it to someone seeing you off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、その方が来たら切符を渡してください。見送りの方は改札を通る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please hand over the ticket when that person arrives. Are those seeing you off planning to go through the gate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、改札の外で別れます。六人全員で中へ入るようには案内しなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見送りは改札外で別れ六人全員を入場案内しなくてよいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, we'll say goodbye outside the gate. You don't need to direct all six of us inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that those seeing you off will say goodbye outside the gate, and guidance for all six to enter is unnecessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。乗る四人がそろったら、こちらの表示で列車をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. When the four travelers are all here, please check the train on this display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。全員の集合を待つのでなく、乗車する四人と切符を確認してから改札へ進みます。見送りの人とは外で挨拶します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車四人と切符の確認後に改札へ進み見送りとは外で挨拶すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Rather than waiting for everyone in the group, we'll confirm the four travelers and their tickets before going through the gate. We'll say goodbye to those seeing us off outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the four travelers and tickets before passing the gate and say goodbye outside to those seeing you off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、どうぞお気を付けてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Well then, take care and have a good journey.
